# FY27 Objectives & Key Results

Outcome-oriented goals for the year. Owners are the accountable staff lead. Confidential
matters appear by code name only.

## Objective 1 — Deepen academic impact for the students we serve

| key result | baseline | target | current | confidence | owner |
|------------|----------|--------|---------|------------|-------|
| Lift the share of tutoring students improving 1+ grade level | 71% (FY26) | 80% | 73% | medium | Sarah Chen |
| Hold Bright Futures college-enrollment rate at or above prior cohort | 88% (Spring cohort) | 85% | in progress | medium | Andre Willis |
| Hold 12 family literacy nights across the 6 tutoring sites | — | 12 events | 3 held | high | Tasha Brooks |

| key result | baseline | target | current | confidence | owner |
